run_cbt_default_teacher: run the DefaultTeacher to train on all CBT tasks including NE, CN, V, and P at once
run_cbt_ne_teacher: run the NETeacher to train on the CBT negative emotion cloze task dataset
run_cbt_cn_teacher: run the CNTeacher to train on the CBT cognitive network cloze task dataset
run_cbt_v_teacher: run the VTeacher to train on the CBT validation cloze task dataset
run_cbt_p_teacher: run the PTeacher to train on the CBT positive emotion cloze task dataset
